evals.prompt: I'm done with my feature branch. Can you open a PR for me?
evals.expected_output: Agent reads *config.md, runs git diff to analyse changes, extracts work item ID(s) from the branch name or commits, generates a PR title and description following the template, then creates the PR via the MCP tool and reports the PR URL.
assertions: Agent reads a *config.md file before generating the PR
Agent calls git diff or equivalent to read the actual changes
PR title follows the <change-type>(area): description format
PR description includes What Changed, Why, and Quality Gates sections
Agent reports the PR URL after creation
Work item ID is extracted from branch name or commit messages if present

evals.prompt: feature/42156/ST2/add-rate-limiting is ready. Create a pull request targeting the develop branch.
evals.expected_output: Agent extracts work item #42156, uses develop as targetRefName, generates appropriate PR title and description, creates PR via MCP.
assertions: Work item #42156 is included in the workItems field

evals.prompt: Can you review the open PRs and tell me which ones need attention?
evals.expected_output: Agent should NOT use this skill — the task is reviewing existing PRs, not creating a new one. Agent handles this directly without invoking pr-generator.
assertions: Agent does not read a pr-generator-config.md
Agent answers the question about existing PRs using available tools

evals.prompt: summarize what changed in my last commit so I can paste it into a PR description
evals.expected_output: Agent uses this skill to generate a PR description from the diff, even though the user didn't say 'create PR'. Agent may offer to create the PR or just output the description.
assertions: Agent reads the git diff or recent commit
Agent produces a structured PR description with What Changed and Why sections
Description is factual and based on actual diff content
